product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides connected construction-management software for commercial general contractors to manage preconstruction, projects, financials, and workflows through closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: Product and target customer are stated on the platform page.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes project-volume-based tiers and estimates/custom quotes.

named_customers.notes: Shaub has a case study; RedTeam's homepage names ASI General Contractors in a customer testimonial.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Orlando, Florida as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company states it has helped contractors since 2006.

eng_blog.notes: Public blog content found consists of marketing, product and industry articles; no qualifying engineering or technical build posts were found.

public_docs.notes: The linked public Help Center is a documentation/support resource with multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Careers portal exists; no current AI, ML, or data-science role was found.

model_provider.notes: Product materials, public help resources, blog and available privacy/security material did not disclose an AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company page inspected did not identify any of the named certifications; no definitive security/trust or legal certification list could be confirmed.

last_funding.notes: A February 2022 funding report describes a $28 million raise; funding profile identifies the round as Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round shown is dated February 2, 2022, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A careers link exists, but an accessible live list of all current job titles could not be verified.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated release notes inspected describe maintenance and usability updates rather than launching a new product or major feature.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Verified CEO, CTO, and VP appointments or departures were announced in 2024, outside the 12-month window; no qualifying 2025–2026 C-level or VP change was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: RedTeam's cookie policy identifies HubSpot as used to implement website forms.
